question.text: Any renewal of portfolio on maturity of the initial period is deemed:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Regulation treats renewal as fresh placement (except for co-investment PMs). **The Trap:** Automatic rollover misstates the rule. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same PM Regs 2020 rule. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Re-execute fresh agreements at renewal to avoid ambiguity.
